Scene 03

US PENETENTIARY

Marshal Daddo

Life without chance of parole... For the premeditated and sadistic sexual murders... Of five twin cities women in 1994. Donald addy faster. You two put this man away.

Fox Mulder

Yeah. Someone forgot to throw away the key.

Marshal Daddo

That's another story. Right now we have to apprehend this man. We'd use all the help you can give us in understanding exactly who it is we're after.

Fox Mulder

Donny faster is a death fetishist-- a collector of bone and dead flesh, of toenails and hair. It's what floats his boat, gets him off.

Marshal Daddo

He's a sick man.

Fox Mulder

Sick would describe him. We found women's fingers in his freezer. He liked to eat them with his peas and carrots.

Marshal Daddo

So it's just women he's after.

Fox Mulder

Just women. Been five years in here thinkin' about only that. I'm sure he's worked up quite an appetite.

Marshal Daddo

I happen to know you two agents have a particular forte, a thing for-- what is it called-- the supernatural? Now, the circumstances of the escape--

Dana Scully

I promise you there is nothing supernatural about this man. Donny faster is just plain evil.

♪♪ [ "don't look any further" ]

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Not a man. Donny faster. He didn't just escape. He walked out. He walked out of a maximum security facility and no one seems to know how he did it.

Dana Scully

Isn't that why we're here?

Fox Mulder

That's why I'm here. I don't know about you. Why are you here? Go home, Scully.

Dana Scully

Mulder, this case doesn't bother me.

Fox Mulder

The man abducted you. Donny faster did a number on your head like I've never seen. And it's okay to... Walk away.

Dana Scully

Mulder, that man does things to people that no one should ever have to think about. It's not a question of if I should stay. I don't have a choice. So let's get to work.

Fox Mulder

Well, this isn't the first incident. Two Prisoners have escaped from maximum security facilities... In neighboring states over the past year. At 6:06 this morning, donny faster made it three.

Dana Scully

6:06? And what's so supernatural about that?

Fox Mulder

Dozens of witnesses, guards and staff and no one seems to remember anything. For a while they didn't even know these guys were missing.

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Neither of the men have ever been seen again.

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

What did he say?

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

I never thought about it before. It never meant anything to me until yesterday when it made me remember something.

Fox Mulder

What?

Dana Scully

When I was 13, my father was stationed in san diego. I was listening to the radio to that song... When my mother came in and told me that my sunday schoolteacher had been killed. Mmm. He'd been murdered in his front yard. And that's the first time I ever felt there was real evil in the world. Mulder, rev. Orison called me "scout." that's the same name my sunday schoolteacher called me. Donny faster escaped from prison at 6:06 a.m. That's exactly the same time that I woke up yesterday morning when my power went out.

Fox Mulder

So, what do you think that god is telling you? Yeah, all right. Come with me, scout. I'll show you how the Reverend talks to god.

Scene 09

Scene 09

Fox Mulder

It's a cerebral edema.

Dana Scully

A swelling of the brain. A trauma not uncommon with this kind of head injury or accident.

Fox Mulder

Except this isn't accidental. The cause, in fact, as it was stated to me, is self-inflicted. There's a small hole here in the skull... Which allows oxygen into the brain cavity. The result of which is the rev. Orison has three times the normal blood volume... Pumping through his brain.

Dana Scully

And he did this himself?

Fox Mulder

Yeah. My guess is he probably did it when he first got into prison-- when he first learned how to use its powers.

Dana Scully

"its powers"?

Fox Mulder

There's a theory... That at this point in human evolution our mental capabilities... Are limited only by inadequate blood supply. In fact, centuries ago in the peruvian andes, holy men used to physically remove parts of their skull in order to increase blood volume, or drill small holes.

Dana Scully

So this hole in his head enables rev. Orison to help these Prisoners escape?

Fox Mulder

Yeah. The practitioners of this... Found that they could perform certain mental tricks. One of which they called "stopping the world."

Dana Scully

Nobody can stop the world. I don't care how many holes they have in their head.

Fox Mulder

But maybe they can alter perception of it, creating a disparate version of reality which they can then project through hypnosis.

Dana Scully

But why? I mean, even if he could, why?

Fox Mulder

Donny faster is serving a life sentence without possibility of parole. That's the final judgment as far as society is concerned, but not in the eyes of god... Or in the eyes of a man who thinks he's god's tool.

Dana Scully

Well, then if rev. Orison meant to kill donny faster, then why is he still alive?

Fox Mulder

I don't know. Maybe he unleashed something that he couldn't control. Maybe he thought he was opening the door of perception, but then unwittingly he... Opened the gates of hell.
